import BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePrefix250
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ZipperRuns

/-!
The pulse gadget and safe reuse of its initial-state zero row.

Source-only draft: no compiler invocation has been performed in this lane.
The two three-transition identities hold in arbitrary finite zipper contexts
and transfer to the existing complete-tape Core semantics via `ZipRep`.
The incoming-edge invariant proves that the actual blank run cannot use
old97/read0 after its first transition. No register or consistency endpoint
is claimed here. Attribution and the exact table identity are in TablePrefix250.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Pulse

open FiniteZipper ZipperRuns

private abbrev test := oldStatePrefix250 75
private abbrev pulse := oldStatePrefix250 255
private abbrev entry := oldStatePrefix250 97
private abbrev rollback := oldStatePrefix250 112
private abbrev reverseCarry := oldStatePrefix250 131
private abbrev seed := oldStatePrefix250 83

/-- At the intermediate state, the cell just left of the head is one.
At the reused initial state, the currently scanned cell is one. -/
def PulseSafe {n : Nat} (qPulse qEntry : Fin n) (c : Config n) : Prop :=
  (c.state = some qPulse → Tape.read c.tape (c.head - 1) = true) ∧
  (c.state = some qEntry → Tape.read c.tape c.head = true)

/-- The recurrence invariant only needs the two incoming-edge facts and
those two literal rows. It also handles already halted configurations. -/
theorem pulseSafe_step {n : Nat} (M : Machine n)
    (qTest qPulse qEntry : Fin n)
    (intoPulse : ∀ q b, (M.transition q b).next = some qPulse →
      q = qTest ∧ b = false)
    (intoEntry : ∀ q b, (M.transition q b).next = some qEntry →
      q = qPulse ∧ b = false)
    (testRow : M.transition qTest false = ⟨true, .right, some qPulse⟩)
    (pulseRow : M.transition qPulse false = ⟨true, .left, some qEntry⟩)
    (c : Config n) (hc : PulseSafe qPulse qEntry c) :
    PulseSafe qPulse qEntry (M.step c) := by
  rcases c with ⟨state, head, tape⟩
  cases state with
  | none => exact hc
  | some q =>
    constructor
    · intro hn
      change (M.transition q (Tape.read tape head)).next = some qPulse at hn
      obtain ⟨rfl, hb⟩ := intoPulse q (Tape.read tape head) hn
      simp only [Machine.step, hb, testRow, Move.apply]
      simpa using Tape.read_write_same tape head true
    · intro hn
      change (M.transition q (Tape.read tape head)).next = some qEntry at hn
      obtain ⟨rfl, hb⟩ := intoEntry q (Tape.read tape head) hn
      have hleft : Tape.read tape (head - 1) = true := hc.1 rfl
      simp only [Machine.step, hb, pulseRow, Move.apply]
      rw [Tape.read_write_of_ne tape (by omega : head - 1 ≠ head) true]
      exact hleft

/-- Preservation over every natural duration, without a runtime bound. -/
theorem pulseSafe_runFrom {n : Nat} (M : Machine n)
    (qTest qPulse qEntry : Fin n)
    (intoPulse : ∀ q b, (M.transition q b).next = some qPulse →
      q = qTest ∧ b = false)
    (intoEntry : ∀ q b, (M.transition q b).next = some qEntry →
      q = qPulse ∧ b = false)
    (testRow : M.transition qTest false = ⟨true, .right, some qPulse⟩)
    (pulseRow : M.transition qPulse false = ⟨true, .left, some qEntry⟩)
    (c : Config n) (hc : PulseSafe qPulse qEntry c) (t : Nat) :
    PulseSafe qPulse qEntry (M.runFrom c t) := by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact hc
  | succ t ih =>
    exact pulseSafe_step M qTest qPulse qEntry intoPulse intoEntry
      testRow pulseRow (M.runFrom c t) ih

/-- Complete three-step zero/zero pulse identity on the final table. -/
theorem pulse_zero_zero (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250 (zAt test h l (false :: false :: r)) 3 =
      leftAt reverseCarry h l (true :: true :: r) := by
  rw [zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old75_false,
    zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old255_false,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old97_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Complete three-step zero/one rollback identity on the final table. -/
theorem pulse_zero_one (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250 (zAt test h l (false :: true :: r)) 3 =
      leftAt rollback h l (false :: true :: r) := by
  rw [zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old75_false,
    zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old255_true,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old131_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Both local cases, retaining arbitrary exterior contexts. -/
theorem pulse_zero (b : Bool) (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250 (zAt test h l (false :: b :: r)) 3 =
      leftAt (if b then rollback else reverseCarry) h l ((!b) :: true :: r) := by
  cases b with
  | false => exact pulse_zero_zero h l r
  | true => exact pulse_zero_one h l r

/-- The local identity is about actual Core runs and the entire represented
infinite tape, not merely a bounded inspection of the two changed cells. -/
theorem pulse_core {c : Config 250} (b : Bool) (h : Int) (l r : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt test h l (false :: b :: r))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix250.runFrom c 3)
      (leftAt (if b then rollback else reverseCarry) h l ((!b) :: true :: r)) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machinePrefix250 3 hc
  rw [pulse_zero] at hs
  exact hs

/-- Actual canonical start zero writes the one-cell seed. -/
theorem blank_first_step :
    machinePrefix250.run 1 =
      ({ state := some seed, head := 1, tape := [0] } : Config 250) := by
  decide

private theorem safe_first_step :
    PulseSafe pulse entry (machinePrefix250.run 1) := by
  rw [blank_first_step]
  constructor
  · intro hn
    exact False.elim ((by decide : seed ≠ pulse) (Option.some.inj hn))
  · intro hn
    exact False.elim ((by decide : seed ≠ entry) (Option.some.inj hn))

/-- Every actual blank-run configuration after initialization is pulse-safe. -/
theorem safe_after_first (t : Nat) :
    PulseSafe pulse entry (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)) := by
  have hs := pulseSafe_runFrom machinePrefix250 test pulse entry
    (fun q b h => (machinePrefix250_into_old255_iff q b).mp h)
    (fun q b h => (machinePrefix250_into_old97_iff q b).mp h)
    rowPrefix250_old75_false rowPrefix250_old255_false
    (machinePrefix250.run 1) safe_first_step t
  rw [← Machine.run_add_eq_runFrom] at hs
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm 1 t] using hs

/-- The reused initial state scans one at every positive runtime occurrence. -/
theorem recurrent_entry_reads_one (t : Nat)
    (hs : (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)).state = some entry) :
    Tape.read (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)).tape
      (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)).head = true :=
  (safe_after_first t).2 hs

/-- The initializer row is used only at the actual initial instant. -/
theorem initializer_only_at_zero (t : Nat)
    (hs : (machinePrefix250.run t).state = some entry)
    (hb : Tape.read (machinePrefix250.run t).tape
      (machinePrefix250.run t).head = false) : t = 0 := by
  cases t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t =>
    have ht := recurrent_entry_reads_one t hs
    rw [hb] at ht
    cases ht

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Pulse

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Pulse

open SetTheory.BusyBeaver SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open Prefix250Pulse FiniteZipper ZipperRuns

#print axioms pulseSafe_step
#print axioms pulseSafe_runFrom
#print axioms pulse_zero
#print axioms pulse_core
#print axioms blank_first_step
#print axioms safe_after_first
#print axioms recurrent_entry_reads_one
#print axioms initializer_only_at_zero

example (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250
      (zAt (oldStatePrefix250 75) h l (false :: false :: r)) 3 =
    leftAt (oldStatePrefix250 131) h l (true :: true :: r) :=
  pulse_zero_zero h l r

example (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250
      (zAt (oldStatePrefix250 75) h l (false :: true :: r)) 3 =
    leftAt (oldStatePrefix250 112) h l (false :: true :: r) :=
  pulse_zero_one h l r

example {c : Config 250} (b : Bool) (h : Int) (l r : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt (oldStatePrefix250 75) h l (false :: b :: r))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix250.runFrom c 3)
      (leftAt (if b then oldStatePrefix250 112 else oldStatePrefix250 131)
        h l ((!b) :: true :: r)) := pulse_core b h l r hc

example (t : Nat)
    (hs : (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)).state = some (oldStatePrefix250 97)) :
    Tape.read (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)).tape
      (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)).head = true := recurrent_entry_reads_one t hs

example (t : Nat)
    (hs : (machinePrefix250.run t).state = some (oldStatePrefix250 97))
    (hb : Tape.read (machinePrefix250.run t).tape
      (machinePrefix250.run t).head = false) : t = 0 := initializer_only_at_zero t hs hb

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded exact250 pulse proof; four selected project providers, no rebuild.
The table PASS record pin must be frozen after the root's successful table run.
Prepare-only performs no compiler or version invocation. Proof mode compiles
only Prefix250Pulse and its focused audit, serially, with a fresh output object.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, time

MODULE = 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Pulse'
PREFIX = 'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Pulse.'
SOURCE_SHA = 'fdf8ff144b680aa4e35e998fe3b0435f18ec8759af0a8be01dd9b826ce278464'
AUDIT_SHA = '731783c881ec167c668cc4d2d0f497b2600dc052650d152712793a6a0e1308e7'
TABLE_RECORD_SHA = '5a8724f11bb54623a271ed54f4e58fa285dc9debab6a19403b949e30607f4767'
MP_RECORD_SHA = '92c2bddc7390806e81b30daa15c2bcfe082dcae6555392a57fe6d1ae987df81b'
EXPECTED = {
    'BusyBeaver.Core': ('436336133fa107c62eb00322333ec9451a0705964bd2b62fce3f44ce848672a6', '2c18d0fc971038cdd3cf5998857f56a88ea1cf33cd11f90f6794866fcc2e1148'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.FiniteZipper': ('f7b41631975f0c243bcb6e48a6c566adde0866fb93f7105571e310c18db45066', 'bfbfb31d4cd560b52a65a832777d64f544dc6a1bbbb080829cc1465881d44101'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.ZipperRuns': ('fc8f39330f6551fb2b29db22127efbb361dd421290b47ca95d1088d7104a3d48', 'f6280bb230bb5f816c27fcd7789aa16a3890d5a0ac3c0d74bd4ac9a19006e8b6'),
}
PROBES = ['pulseSafe_step', 'pulseSafe_runFrom', 'pulse_zero', 'pulse_core',
          'blank_first_step', 'safe_after_first', 'recurrent_entry_reads_one',
          'initializer_only_at_zero']
CALLERS = 5
TIMEOUT = 120

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--table-evidence', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--source', type=Path)
p.add_argument('--audit', type=Path)
p.add_argument('--prepare-only', action='store_true')
a = p.parse_args()
if not __debug__:
    p.error('Assertions must remain enabled.')
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
R = a.repo.resolve()
W = a.output.resolve()
assert not W.is_relative_to(R) and (not W.exists() or not any(W.iterdir()))
assert TABLE_RECORD_SHA != 'PENDING_SUCCESSFUL_TABLE_RECORD', 'Freeze successful table evidence before preparation or compilation.'
S = a.source.resolve() if a.source else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix250-lean/retiming/Prefix250Pulse.lean')
A = a.audit.resolve() if a.audit else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix250-lean/retiming/Audit.lean')
assert sha(S) == SOURCE_SHA and sha(A) == AUDIT_SHA
E = a.table_evidence.resolve()
MP = R / 'Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-mp254-verification.json'
assert sha(E) == TABLE_RECORD_SHA and sha(MP) == MP_RECORD_SHA
parent, mp = json.loads(E.read_text()), json.loads(MP.read_text())
for d in (parent, mp):
    assert d['status'] == 'PASS' and d['only_standard_axioms']
    assert d['all_input_provider_postchecks'] and d['all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit']
    assert len(d['commands']) == 2 and all(q['exit_code'] == 0 for q in d['commands'])
    assert [q['label'] for q in d['commands']] == ['source', 'audit']
C = Path(parent['compiler']['path']).resolve()
assert parent['compiler']['sha256'] == mp['compiler']['sha256'] == sha(C)
assert parent['compiler']['version'] == mp['compiler']['version']
version = parent['compiler']['version']
toolroot = C.parent.parent / 'lib/lean'

def imports(path):
    text = Path(path).read_text()
    return re.findall(r'^import\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\s*$', text, re.M)

assert imports(S) == ['BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePrefix250', 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.ZipperRuns']
assert imports(A) == [MODULE]
assert re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)$', A.read_text(), re.M) == PROBES
assert len(re.findall(r'^example\b', A.read_text(), re.M)) == CALLERS
# Reject new unchecked proof exits and enlarged elaboration budgets.
for f in (S, A):
    assert not re.search(r'\b(sorry|admit|native_decide)\b', f.read_text())
    assert not re.search(r'set_option\s+(maxHeartbeats|maxRecDepth)', f.read_text())
pool = {q['module']: q for q in mp['reused_modules']}
selected = {}
for m, (source_sha, object_sha) in EXPECTED.items():
    q = pool[m]
    source = R / 'Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean' / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.lean')
    obj = Path(q['object']).resolve()
    assert q['source_sha256'] == source_sha == sha(source)
    assert q['object_sha256'] == object_sha == sha(obj)
    selected[m] = dict(module=m, source=str(source), source_sha256=source_sha,
                       object=str(obj), object_sha256=object_sha, evidence=str(MP))
fresh = [q for q in parent['fresh_modules'] if q['module'] == 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePrefix250']
assert len(fresh) == 1
q = fresh[0]
table_source = Path(parent['source']['path']).resolve()
table_snapshot = Path(parent['source']['snapshot']).resolve()
assert q['source_sha256'] == parent['source']['sha256'] == sha(table_source) == sha(table_snapshot)
table_object = Path(q['path']).resolve()
assert sha(table_object) == q['sha256']
selected[q['module']] = dict(module=q['module'], source=str(table_source),
    source_sha256=sha(table_source), object=str(table_object), object_sha256=sha(table_object), evidence=str(E))
# The fresh table must have used the identical Core import selected here.
parent_core = next(q for q in parent['reused_modules'] if q['module'] == 'BusyBeaver.Core')
assert (parent_core['source_sha256'], parent_core['object_sha256']) == EXPECTED['BusyBeaver.Core']
visiting, closure, tool_names = set(), [], {'Init'}
def visit(m):
    if m in closure:
        return
    assert m in selected and m not in visiting
    visiting.add(m)
    for n in imports(selected[m]['source']):
        if n == 'Init' or n.startswith(('Lean.', 'Std.')):
            tool_names.add(n)
        else:
            visit(n)
    visiting.remove(m)
    closure.append(m)
for m in imports(S):
    visit(m)
assert set(closure) == set(selected) and len(closure) == 4
W.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cache, snap = W / 'cache', W / 'sources'
cache.mkdir()
ss = snap / Path(MODULE.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.lean')
ss.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
aa = snap / 'Audit.lean'
shutil.copyfile(S, ss)
shutil.copyfile(A, aa)
for m in closure:
    dest = cache / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest.symlink_to(selected[m]['object'])
def first(m):
    rel = Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    return next(q / rel for q in (cache, toolroot) if (q / rel).is_file())
actual = []
for m in closure:
    obj = first(m)
    assert sha(obj) == selected[m]['object_sha256']
    actual.append(dict(module=m, actual_first=str(obj), resolved=str(obj.resolve()), sha256=sha(obj)))
tools = []
for m in sorted(tool_names):
    ref = toolroot / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    obj = first(m)
    assert obj.resolve() == ref.resolve()
    tools.append(dict(module=m, object=str(ref), object_sha256=sha(ref), actual_first=str(obj)))
inputs = [Path(__file__).resolve(), S, A, E, MP, C, table_snapshot, ss, aa]
for q in selected.values():
    inputs += [Path(q['source']), Path(q['object'])]
inputs += [Path(q['object']) for q in tools]
inputs = list(dict.fromkeys(q.resolve() for q in inputs))
before = {str(q): sha(q) for q in inputs}
env = dict(os.environ, LEAN_PATH=str(cache), LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1')
r = dict(status='PREPARED_NOT_BUILT' if a.prepare_only else 'RUNNING', scope=__doc__,
    prepare_only=a.prepare_only, compiler=dict(path=str(C), version=version, sha256=sha(C),
    compiler_version_query_performed=False), source_overridden=a.source is not None,
    audit_overridden=a.audit is not None, source=dict(path=str(S), sha256=sha(S), snapshot=str(ss)),
    audit=dict(path=str(A), sha256=sha(A), snapshot=str(aa)),
    provider_evidence=[dict(path=str(q), sha256=sha(q)) for q in (E, MP)],
    reused_modules=[selected[m] for m in closure], exact_project_import_closure=True,
    project_module_count=4, external_project_boundaries=[], toolchain_providers=tools,
    actual_first_providers=actual, actual_direct_tool_imports=sorted(tool_names),
    before=before, commands=[], fresh_modules=[], LEAN_PATH=env['LEAN_PATH'],
    dependency_build=False, downloads=False, per_command_timeout_seconds=TIMEOUT,
    shared_wall_seconds=TIMEOUT)
def save():
    (W / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
def post():
    after = {str(q): sha(q) for q in inputs}
    assert before == after
    for m in closure:
        assert sha(first(m)) == selected[m]['object_sha256']
    for q in tools:
        assert sha(first(q['module'])) == q['object_sha256']
    r.update(after=after, all_input_provider_postchecks=True)
save()
if a.prepare_only:
    post()
    save()
    print(W / 'verification.json')
    raise SystemExit(0)
deadline = time.monotonic() + TIMEOUT
def run(label, source, obj=None):
    cmd = [str(C), '-j1', '-M4096', '--root=' + str(snap)]
    if obj is not None:
        cmd += ['-o', str(obj)]
    cmd += [str(source)]
    began = time.monotonic()
    remaining = deadline - began
    assert remaining > 0, 'Shared proof wall budget exhausted.'
    try:
        cp = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=snap, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=remaining)
        output, code = cp.stdout + cp.stderr, cp.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as ex:
        def decoded(x):
            return x.decode(errors='replace') if isinstance(x, bytes) else x or ''
        output, code = decoded(ex.stdout) + decoded(ex.stderr) + '\nTIMEOUT\n', -1
    (W / (label + '.log')).write_text(output)
    r['commands'].append(dict(label=label, command=cmd, seconds=time.monotonic() - began,
                              exit_code=code, output=output))
    save()
    assert code == 0 and 'sorryAx' not in output and "declaration uses 'sorry'" not in output, output
    return output
try:
    obj = cache / Path(MODULE.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    run('source', ss, obj)
    assert obj.is_file() and not obj.is_symlink()
    oh = sha(obj)
    source_object = dict(module=MODULE, path=str(obj), sha256=oh, source_sha256=sha(S))
    r.update(source_object_recorded_before_audit=True, source_pass_object=source_object,
             fresh_modules=[source_object])
    assert first(MODULE).resolve() == obj.resolve()
    r['fresh_first_provider_before_audit'] = dict(module=MODULE, path=str(first(MODULE)), sha256=sha(first(MODULE)))
    save()
    audit_output = run('audit', aa)
    reports = re.findall(r"'([^']+)'\s+(?:depends on axioms:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]|does not depend on any axioms)", audit_output, re.S)
    assert [n for n, _ in reports] == [PREFIX + n for n in PROBES]
    assert all({x.strip() for x in axioms.split(',') if x.strip()} <=
               {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'} for _, axioms in reports)
    post()
    assert sha(obj) == oh and sha(first(MODULE)) == oh
    r.update(status='PASS', all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit=True,
             named_axiom_probes=len(PROBES), callers=CALLERS, only_standard_axioms=True,
             warnings={q['label']: q['output'].count('warning:') for q in r['commands']})
except Exception as ex:
    r.update(status='FAIL', error=str(ex))
    try:
        post()
    except Exception as post_error:
        r['postcheck_error'] = str(post_error)
    save()
    raise
save()
print(W / 'verification.json')

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePrefix250
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ZipperRuns

/-!
The pulse gadget and safe reuse of its initial-state zero row.

Source-only draft: no compiler invocation has been performed in this lane.
The two three-transition identities hold in arbitrary finite zipper contexts
and transfer to the existing complete-tape Core semantics via `ZipRep`.
The incoming-edge invariant proves that the actual blank run cannot use
old97/read0 after its first transition. No register or consistency endpoint
is claimed here. Attribution and the exact table identity are in TablePrefix250.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Pulse

open FiniteZipper ZipperRuns

private abbrev test := oldStatePrefix250 75
private abbrev pulse := oldStatePrefix250 255
private abbrev entry := oldStatePrefix250 97
private abbrev rollback := oldStatePrefix250 112
private abbrev reverseCarry := oldStatePrefix250 131
private abbrev seed := oldStatePrefix250 83

/-- At the intermediate state, the cell just left of the head is one.
At the reused initial state, the currently scanned cell is one. -/
def PulseSafe {n : Nat} (qPulse qEntry : Fin n) (c : Config n) : Prop :=
  (c.state = some qPulse → Tape.read c.tape (c.head - 1) = true) ∧
  (c.state = some qEntry → Tape.read c.tape c.head = true)

/-- The recurrence invariant only needs the two incoming-edge facts and
those two literal rows. It also handles already halted configurations. -/
theorem pulseSafe_step {n : Nat} (M : Machine n)
    (qTest qPulse qEntry : Fin n)
    (intoPulse : ∀ q b, (M.transition q b).next = some qPulse →
      q = qTest ∧ b = false)
    (intoEntry : ∀ q b, (M.transition q b).next = some qEntry →
      q = qPulse ∧ b = false)
    (testRow : M.transition qTest false = ⟨true, .right, some qPulse⟩)
    (pulseRow : M.transition qPulse false = ⟨true, .left, some qEntry⟩)
    (c : Config n) (hc : PulseSafe qPulse qEntry c) :
    PulseSafe qPulse qEntry (M.step c) := by
  rcases c with ⟨state, head, tape⟩
  cases state with
  | none => exact hc
  | some q =>
    constructor
    · intro hn
      change (M.transition q (Tape.read tape head)).next = some qPulse at hn
      obtain ⟨rfl, hb⟩ := intoPulse q (Tape.read tape head) hn
      simp only [Machine.step, hb, testRow, Move.apply]
      simpa using Tape.read_write_same tape head true
    · intro hn
      change (M.transition q (Tape.read tape head)).next = some qEntry at hn
      obtain ⟨rfl, hb⟩ := intoEntry q (Tape.read tape head) hn
      have hleft : Tape.read tape (head - 1) = true := hc.1 rfl
      simp only [Machine.step, hb, pulseRow, Move.apply]
      rw [Tape.read_write_of_ne tape (by omega : head - 1 ≠ head) true]
      exact hleft

/-- Preservation over every natural duration, without a runtime bound. -/
theorem pulseSafe_runFrom {n : Nat} (M : Machine n)
    (qTest qPulse qEntry : Fin n)
    (intoPulse : ∀ q b, (M.transition q b).next = some qPulse →
      q = qTest ∧ b = false)
    (intoEntry : ∀ q b, (M.transition q b).next = some qEntry →
      q = qPulse ∧ b = false)
    (testRow : M.transition qTest false = ⟨true, .right, some qPulse⟩)
    (pulseRow : M.transition qPulse false = ⟨true, .left, some qEntry⟩)
    (c : Config n) (hc : PulseSafe qPulse qEntry c) (t : Nat) :
    PulseSafe qPulse qEntry (M.runFrom c t) := by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact hc
  | succ t ih =>
    exact pulseSafe_step M qTest qPulse qEntry intoPulse intoEntry
      testRow pulseRow (M.runFrom c t) ih

/-- Complete three-step zero/zero pulse identity on the final table. -/
theorem pulse_zero_zero (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250 (zAt test h l (false :: false :: r)) 3 =
      leftAt reverseCarry h l (true :: true :: r) := by
  rw [zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old75_false,
    zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old255_false,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old97_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Complete three-step zero/one rollback identity on the final table. -/
theorem pulse_zero_one (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250 (zAt test h l (false :: true :: r)) 3 =
      leftAt rollback h l (false :: true :: r) := by
  rw [zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old75_false,
    zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old255_true,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix250_old131_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Both local cases, retaining arbitrary exterior contexts. -/
theorem pulse_zero (b : Bool) (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix250 (zAt test h l (false :: b :: r)) 3 =
      leftAt (if b then rollback else reverseCarry) h l ((!b) :: true :: r) := by
  cases b with
  | false => exact pulse_zero_zero h l r
  | true => exact pulse_zero_one h l r

/-- The local identity is about actual Core runs and the entire represented
infinite tape, not merely a bounded inspection of the two changed cells. -/
theorem pulse_core {c : Config 250} (b : Bool) (h : Int) (l r : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt test h l (false :: b :: r))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix250.runFrom c 3)
      (leftAt (if b then rollback else reverseCarry) h l ((!b) :: true :: r)) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machinePrefix250 3 hc
  rw [pulse_zero] at hs
  exact hs

/-- Actual canonical start zero writes the one-cell seed. -/
theorem blank_first_step :
    machinePrefix250.run 1 =
      ({ state := some seed, head := 1, tape := [0] } : Config 250) := by
  decide +kernel

private theorem safe_first_step :
    PulseSafe pulse entry (machinePrefix250.run 1) := by
  rw [blank_first_step]
  constructor
  · intro hn
    exact False.elim ((by decide : seed ≠ pulse) (Option.some.inj hn))
  · intro hn
    exact False.elim ((by decide : seed ≠ entry) (Option.some.inj hn))

/-- Every actual blank-run configuration after initialization is pulse-safe. -/
theorem safe_after_first (t : Nat) :
    PulseSafe pulse entry (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)) := by
  have hs := pulseSafe_runFrom machinePrefix250 test pulse entry
    (fun q b h => (machinePrefix250_into_old255_iff q b).mp h)
    (fun q b h => (machinePrefix250_into_old97_iff q b).mp h)
    rowPrefix250_old75_false rowPrefix250_old255_false
    (machinePrefix250.run 1) safe_first_step t
  rw [← Machine.run_add_eq_runFrom] at hs
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm 1 t] using hs

/-- The reused initial state scans one at every positive runtime occurrence. -/
theorem recurrent_entry_reads_one (t : Nat)
    (hs : (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)).state = some entry) :
    Tape.read (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)).tape
      (machinePrefix250.run (t + 1)).head = true :=
  (safe_after_first t).2 hs

/-- The initializer row is used only at the actual initial instant. -/
theorem initializer_only_at_zero (t : Nat)
    (hs : (machinePrefix250.run t).state = some entry)
    (hb : Tape.read (machinePrefix250.run t).tape
      (machinePrefix250.run t).head = false) : t = 0 := by
  cases t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t =>
    have ht := recurrent_entry_reads_one t hs
    rw [hb] at ht
    cases ht

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Pulse

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded exact250 pulse proof; four selected project providers, no rebuild.
The table PASS record pin must be frozen after the root's successful table run.
Prepare-only performs no compiler or version invocation. Proof mode compiles
only Prefix250Pulse and its focused audit, serially, with a fresh output object.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, time

MODULE = 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Pulse'
PREFIX = 'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix250Pulse.'
SOURCE_SHA = '0a8037dea879cc917302b565b5bfb43fdd63fcf54495ccdc51d4680590028b8d'
AUDIT_SHA = '731783c881ec167c668cc4d2d0f497b2600dc052650d152712793a6a0e1308e7'
TABLE_RECORD_SHA = '5a8724f11bb54623a271ed54f4e58fa285dc9debab6a19403b949e30607f4767'
MP_RECORD_SHA = '92c2bddc7390806e81b30daa15c2bcfe082dcae6555392a57fe6d1ae987df81b'
EXPECTED = {
    'BusyBeaver.Core': ('436336133fa107c62eb00322333ec9451a0705964bd2b62fce3f44ce848672a6', '2c18d0fc971038cdd3cf5998857f56a88ea1cf33cd11f90f6794866fcc2e1148'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.FiniteZipper': ('f7b41631975f0c243bcb6e48a6c566adde0866fb93f7105571e310c18db45066', 'bfbfb31d4cd560b52a65a832777d64f544dc6a1bbbb080829cc1465881d44101'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.ZipperRuns': ('fc8f39330f6551fb2b29db22127efbb361dd421290b47ca95d1088d7104a3d48', 'f6280bb230bb5f816c27fcd7789aa16a3890d5a0ac3c0d74bd4ac9a19006e8b6'),
}
PROBES = ['pulseSafe_step', 'pulseSafe_runFrom', 'pulse_zero', 'pulse_core',
          'blank_first_step', 'safe_after_first', 'recurrent_entry_reads_one',
          'initializer_only_at_zero']
CALLERS = 5
TIMEOUT = 120

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--table-evidence', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--source', type=Path)
p.add_argument('--audit', type=Path)
p.add_argument('--prepare-only', action='store_true')
a = p.parse_args()
if not __debug__:
    p.error('Assertions must remain enabled.')
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
R = a.repo.resolve()
W = a.output.resolve()
assert not W.is_relative_to(R) and (not W.exists() or not any(W.iterdir()))
assert TABLE_RECORD_SHA != 'PENDING_SUCCESSFUL_TABLE_RECORD', 'Freeze successful table evidence before preparation or compilation.'
S = a.source.resolve() if a.source else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix250-lean/retiming/Prefix250Pulse.lean')
A = a.audit.resolve() if a.audit else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix250-lean/retiming/Audit.lean')
assert sha(S) == SOURCE_SHA and sha(A) == AUDIT_SHA
E = a.table_evidence.resolve()
MP = R / 'Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-mp254-verification.json'
assert sha(E) == TABLE_RECORD_SHA and sha(MP) == MP_RECORD_SHA
parent, mp = json.loads(E.read_text()), json.loads(MP.read_text())
for d in (parent, mp):
    assert d['status'] == 'PASS' and d['only_standard_axioms']
    assert d['all_input_provider_postchecks'] and d['all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit']
    assert len(d['commands']) == 2 and all(q['exit_code'] == 0 for q in d['commands'])
    assert [q['label'] for q in d['commands']] == ['source', 'audit']
C = Path(parent['compiler']['path']).resolve()
assert parent['compiler']['sha256'] == mp['compiler']['sha256'] == sha(C)
assert parent['compiler']['version'] == mp['compiler']['version']
version = parent['compiler']['version']
toolroot = C.parent.parent / 'lib/lean'

def imports(path):
    text = Path(path).read_text()
    return re.findall(r'^import\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\s*$', text, re.M)

assert imports(S) == ['BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePrefix250', 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.ZipperRuns']
assert imports(A) == [MODULE]
assert re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)$', A.read_text(), re.M) == PROBES
assert len(re.findall(r'^example\b', A.read_text(), re.M)) == CALLERS
# Reject new unchecked proof exits and enlarged elaboration budgets.
for f in (S, A):
    assert not re.search(r'\b(sorry|admit|native_decide)\b', f.read_text())
    assert not re.search(r'set_option\s+(maxHeartbeats|maxRecDepth)', f.read_text())
pool = {q['module']: q for q in mp['reused_modules']}
selected = {}
for m, (source_sha, object_sha) in EXPECTED.items():
    q = pool[m]
    source = R / 'Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean' / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.lean')
    obj = Path(q['object']).resolve()
    assert q['source_sha256'] == source_sha == sha(source)
    assert q['object_sha256'] == object_sha == sha(obj)
    selected[m] = dict(module=m, source=str(source), source_sha256=source_sha,
                       object=str(obj), object_sha256=object_sha, evidence=str(MP))
fresh = [q for q in parent['fresh_modules'] if q['module'] == 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePrefix250']
assert len(fresh) == 1
q = fresh[0]
table_source = Path(parent['source']['path']).resolve()
table_snapshot = Path(parent['source']['snapshot']).resolve()
assert q['source_sha256'] == parent['source']['sha256'] == sha(table_source) == sha(table_snapshot)
table_object = Path(q['path']).resolve()
assert sha(table_object) == q['sha256']
selected[q['module']] = dict(module=q['module'], source=str(table_source),
    source_sha256=sha(table_source), object=str(table_object), object_sha256=sha(table_object), evidence=str(E))
# The fresh table must have used the identical Core import selected here.
parent_core = next(q for q in parent['reused_modules'] if q['module'] == 'BusyBeaver.Core')
assert (parent_core['source_sha256'], parent_core['object_sha256']) == EXPECTED['BusyBeaver.Core']
visiting, closure, tool_names = set(), [], {'Init'}
def visit(m):
    if m in closure:
        return
    assert m in selected and m not in visiting
    visiting.add(m)
    for n in imports(selected[m]['source']):
        if n == 'Init' or n.startswith(('Lean.', 'Std.')):
            tool_names.add(n)
        else:
            visit(n)
    visiting.remove(m)
    closure.append(m)
for m in imports(S):
    visit(m)
assert set(closure) == set(selected) and len(closure) == 4
W.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cache, snap = W / 'cache', W / 'sources'
cache.mkdir()
ss = snap / Path(MODULE.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.lean')
ss.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
aa = snap / 'Audit.lean'
shutil.copyfile(S, ss)
shutil.copyfile(A, aa)
for m in closure:
    dest = cache / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest.symlink_to(selected[m]['object'])
def first(m):
    rel = Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    return next(q / rel for q in (cache, toolroot) if (q / rel).is_file())
actual = []
for m in closure:
    obj = first(m)
    assert sha(obj) == selected[m]['object_sha256']
    actual.append(dict(module=m, actual_first=str(obj), resolved=str(obj.resolve()), sha256=sha(obj)))
tools = []
for m in sorted(tool_names):
    ref = toolroot / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    obj = first(m)
    assert obj.resolve() == ref.resolve()
    tools.append(dict(module=m, object=str(ref), object_sha256=sha(ref), actual_first=str(obj)))
inputs = [Path(__file__).resolve(), S, A, E, MP, C, table_snapshot, ss, aa]
for q in selected.values():
    inputs += [Path(q['source']), Path(q['object'])]
inputs += [Path(q['object']) for q in tools]
inputs = list(dict.fromkeys(q.resolve() for q in inputs))
before = {str(q): sha(q) for q in inputs}
env = dict(os.environ, LEAN_PATH=str(cache), LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1')
r = dict(status='PREPARED_NOT_BUILT' if a.prepare_only else 'RUNNING', scope=__doc__,
    prepare_only=a.prepare_only, compiler=dict(path=str(C), version=version, sha256=sha(C),
    compiler_version_query_performed=False), source_overridden=a.source is not None,
    audit_overridden=a.audit is not None, source=dict(path=str(S), sha256=sha(S), snapshot=str(ss)),
    audit=dict(path=str(A), sha256=sha(A), snapshot=str(aa)),
    provider_evidence=[dict(path=str(q), sha256=sha(q)) for q in (E, MP)],
    reused_modules=[selected[m] for m in closure], exact_project_import_closure=True,
    project_module_count=4, external_project_boundaries=[], toolchain_providers=tools,
    actual_first_providers=actual, actual_direct_tool_imports=sorted(tool_names),
    before=before, commands=[], fresh_modules=[], LEAN_PATH=env['LEAN_PATH'],
    dependency_build=False, downloads=False, per_command_timeout_seconds=TIMEOUT,
    shared_wall_seconds=TIMEOUT)
def save():
    (W / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
def post():
    after = {str(q): sha(q) for q in inputs}
    assert before == after
    for m in closure:
        assert sha(first(m)) == selected[m]['object_sha256']
    for q in tools:
        assert sha(first(q['module'])) == q['object_sha256']
    r.update(after=after, all_input_provider_postchecks=True)
save()
if a.prepare_only:
    post()
    save()
    print(W / 'verification.json')
    raise SystemExit(0)
deadline = time.monotonic() + TIMEOUT
def run(label, source, obj=None):
    cmd = [str(C), '-j1', '-M4096', '--root=' + str(snap)]
    if obj is not None:
        cmd += ['-o', str(obj)]
    cmd += [str(source)]
    began = time.monotonic()
    remaining = deadline - began
    assert remaining > 0, 'Shared proof wall budget exhausted.'
    try:
        cp = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=snap, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=remaining)
        output, code = cp.stdout + cp.stderr, cp.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as ex:
        def decoded(x):
            return x.decode(errors='replace') if isinstance(x, bytes) else x or ''
        output, code = decoded(ex.stdout) + decoded(ex.stderr) + '\nTIMEOUT\n', -1
    (W / (label + '.log')).write_text(output)
    r['commands'].append(dict(label=label, command=cmd, seconds=time.monotonic() - began,
                              exit_code=code, output=output))
    save()
    assert code == 0 and 'sorryAx' not in output and "declaration uses 'sorry'" not in output, output
    return output
try:
    obj = cache / Path(MODULE.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    run('source', ss, obj)
    assert obj.is_file() and not obj.is_symlink()
    oh = sha(obj)
    source_object = dict(module=MODULE, path=str(obj), sha256=oh, source_sha256=sha(S))
    r.update(source_object_recorded_before_audit=True, source_pass_object=source_object,
             fresh_modules=[source_object])
    assert first(MODULE).resolve() == obj.resolve()
    r['fresh_first_provider_before_audit'] = dict(module=MODULE, path=str(first(MODULE)), sha256=sha(first(MODULE)))
    save()
    audit_output = run('audit', aa)
    reports = re.findall(r"'([^']+)'\s+(?:depends on axioms:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]|does not depend on any axioms)", audit_output, re.S)
    assert [n for n, _ in reports] == [PREFIX + n for n in PROBES]
    assert all({x.strip() for x in axioms.split(',') if x.strip()} <=
               {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'} for _, axioms in reports)
    post()
    assert sha(obj) == oh and sha(first(MODULE)) == oh
    r.update(status='PASS', all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit=True,
             named_axiom_probes=len(PROBES), callers=CALLERS, only_standard_axioms=True,
             warnings={q['label']: q['output'].count('warning:') for q in r['commands']})
except Exception as ex:
    r.update(status='FAIL', error=str(ex))
    try:
        post()
    except Exception as post_error:
        r['postcheck_error'] = str(post_error)
    save()
    raise
save()
print(W / 'verification.json')
